title: unified rollouts: enhance canary/A-B/shadow auto-rollback policy and ramping
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: unify and simplify rollout policies used across canary, A/B tests, and shadow traffic while adding metric-driven automated rollback, configurable bake/ramp windows, and improved observability for model lifecycle events. Design: introduce a single RolloutSpec API surface that supports (1) weighted ramps for A/B and canary traffic, (2) shadow copy with sampling controls and shadow alignment checks, (3) metric-driven gates with configurable thresholds, aggregation windows and evaluation frequency, and (4) automatic rollback strategies including consecutive-failure, regression-detection, and threshold-breach policies. This PR implements the core controller changes, runtime routing hooks, CLI flags, e2e integration tests, and docs. Changes are backward compatible: existing simple canary configs map to the new RolloutSpec. Checklist: - [x] Controller: new RolloutSpec parsing and reconciliation - [x] Runtime: routing for weight ramping and shadow dispatch - [x] Metrics: add rollout-specific metrics and traces - [x] Policy engine: metric evaluators and rollback triggers - [x] CLI/API: new flags and validation - [x] Tests: unit + integration + perf canary - [x] Docs: rollout guide and examples Testing: local unit tests, integration test harness in perf-canary, and a staged smoke deployment to a dedicated cluster with synthetic traffic. Observability: dashboards added for rollout progression, per-variant latency/cost deltas, and rollback reasons. Rollout notes: default auto-rollback is disabled for backward compatibility, can be enabled per-rollout. When enabled, the controller evaluates configured metrics every evaluation_interval and triggers rollback if configured policy thresholds are violated for the configured breach_window. Migration: a lightweight migration maps old canary fields to RolloutSpec; policy defaults preserve prior system behavior. Impact: reduces on-call toil by automating common rollback scenarios while providing richer signals to guardrails.

review_comments: Ravi Patel: Nice consolidation. Two asks: 1) add a safety limit so weight ramps never exceed X% per minute, 2) include a table in docs mapping old canary fields to RolloutSpec fields.
Author (Ava Martinez): Addressed both — added ramp_rate config with default 10pct/min and expanded migration doc with field mapping table.
Morgan Lee: Policy engine looks good; please ensure metric evaluation is resilient to NaNs and missing series (suggest fallback to previous window).
Author: Implemented NaN handling and fallback to previous non-empty window; added unit tests.
Elena Korolev: CI flake on the e2e test (timeout) — can we increase the test timeout and add a retry in the harness?
Author: Increased timeout and added a single retry in the e2e harness; CI green on re-run.
release_notes: Unified Rollouts: RolloutSpec with weighted ramps for canary/A-B tests, shadow traffic controls, metric-driven auto-rollback policies, improved rollout observability, CLI flags, and migration notes. Backward compatible defaults preserved.
